current.changeLog:
• Fixed the percentage on tanks with a low mark (below 20 %): the mod showed, for example, 0.18 % where the game showed 3.60 %
• The forecast is exact far more often. The mod now reads the damage distribution the way the game servers do, cuts the percentage to two decimals instead of rounding it, and works out which day's values the servers are on (they switch some hours after new ones are published). On 181 recorded battles, with the damage the server counted, the forecast is exact to the hundredth in 176 (73 in version 1.4.0); a morning battle, while the servers switch, can still be a few hundredths off
• Chance of the next mark on a tank with few battles: it showed 0 % and "1000+ battles" for the first hundred battles or so. The mod now takes into account that the mark is still filling up
• A tank whose mark is still at 0.00 % after its first battle gets its panels too

previous.changeLog:
- Added Heatmap toggle (for more than 100 shots logged)
- Logs moved out of the mods folder to World_of_Tanks/shellLogger_local, so reinstalling mods or a modpack no longer deletes them. Existing logs are moved there automatically on the first start.
- Minor UI improvements and readability fixes. UI scale reset hotkey: R

changes.title: WoT Pedal Accessibility Driver for Logitech G29

current.changeLog:
Version 1.0.1 (2026-10-04)
--------------------------
- Game Compatibility: Verified compatibility with World of Tanks 2.4.0.2.
- Device Detection: Added automatic device instance detection fallback for
  Logitech G29 (VID_046D, PID_C24F) across any USB port/hub, eliminating the
  need for manual instance ID editing on most systems.
- 1-Click Installers: Added convenient Windows batch scripts:
  * Install_WoTPedalDriver.bat (registers autostart background scheduled task)
  * Uninstall_WoTPedalDriver.bat (cleanly stops and removes the task)
  * Run_Directly.bat (run directly in console without scheduler)
- Documentation: Added dedicated English (README_EN.txt) and Polish
  (README_PL.txt) guides with MIT license.
